visual_review.notes: Reviewed on H3 video. Idle v1, hit v1, cast v1 and death v1 are clean; the idle's larger steps are the loader handling a bolt. The crew kept firing the crossbow in its retakes, so the clean frames around each shot are used. Attack v3: the loader draws a bolt and jabs it out (contact video 52); the crossbow smoke at 76-86 is skipped. Ranged v2: the aim (8-14) cuts to the recoil at 34, past the bolt in flight and the flash. Defend v3: the crew ducks behind the crossbow and the clip ends at 56, before the crossbow fires at 60. The walk keeps the published clip.
